newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund outflows narrow -- survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund outflows narrow -- survey.

text.p: Outflows from U.S. stock mutual funds slowed to $107 million for the two-day period ended March 24 from $812 million for the three days ended March 20, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said outflows from aggressive growth funds eased to $49 million from $416 million, growth funds outflows improved to $139 million from $356 million, and international funds rose to inflows of $123 million from outflows of $231 million.

Bond funds also improved to inflows of $47 million from outflows of $110 million, Trim Tabs said. Government/GNMA funds improved to inflows of $52 million from outflows of $88 million. Muni funds rose to inflows of $100 million from inflows of $33 million.
